title: A Noetherian complete local ring is a G-ring
statement: Let $(S,\mathfrak n)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring which is complete, i.e. $\mathfrak n$-adically complete: the canonical map $S\to\varprojlim_nS/\mathfrak n^n$ to its $\mathfrak n$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is bijective. Then $S$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]: for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset S$ the completion map $S_{\mathfrak q}\to(S_{\mathfrak q})^\wedge$ is a regular ring map.
